channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Dräger Partners with MES Life Safety to Expand AirBoss Nationwide
item.description: This alignment significantly bolsters Dräger’s support network across the United States, recognizing the strength of the AirBoss as a compelling, premier SCBA choice for American fire departments.

item.title: CET Fire Pumps Awarded New Sourcewell Fire Apparatus Cooperative Contract
item.description: CET Fire Pumps MFG. has been awarded a new cooperative purchasing contract with Sourcewell, enhancing its role in providing fire apparatus solutions to government agencies.

item.title: CT City Suspends Volunteer Fire Department in Standoff Over City-Wide Unified Command
item.description: Norwich has shut down Yantic Fire Engine Co. No. 1 for noncompliance with a directive aimed at unifying fire services.

item.title: NYC Fire Kills Woman, Injures Others as FDNY Searches for Missing Person
item.description: A fire in Queens resulted in one death and multiple injuries.

item.title: From Fires to False Alarms, High-Rises a Challenge as Ann Arbor (MI) Grows Denser
item.description: The opening of new high-rises in Ann Arbor has increased the workload for the fire department, prompting discussions on the need for additional staffing and resources.

item.title: Heavy Fire From Multiple Windows Greets First-Due Companies at SC Fire
item.description: A large structure fire occurred early Tuesday in Columbia, causing extensive damage to an unoccupied leasing office building.

item.title: CA Firefighters Rescue Person from House Fire; Firefighter Hospitalized
item.description: A person was rescued from a house fire in Ceres early Monday. Firefighters conducted an aggressive search and rescue, and the cause of the fire is under investigation.

item.title: Rideshare Package Pickup in Chicago Spurs Hazmat Response
item.description: Two individuals became ill after picking up a package in Chicago. Both were hospitalized, and a hazmat team is investigating the package.

item.title: NY Crews Respond to Wind-Driven Fire on Long Island
item.description: A fire occurred at a two-story home in North Bellmore, New York, causing garage and second-floor collapses.

item.title: Setting Up Your Equipment for Success, Part 2
item.description: Mike Dugan, Clark Lamping, and the rest of the panel continue their discussion on firefighting equipment. This month they are joined by Steve Robertson of the Columbus (OH) Division of Fire to talk engine company operations.
